style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: a respectful editorial interpretation using earth tones, natural material texture, animal-land relationships and restrained symbolic language, without copying sacred or nation-specific motifs or a living artist.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 关税、AI、气候与文化共同进入执行周末
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球系统同时接受规则与承载力检验
zh-CN.headlineFull: 关税、AI、气候与文化共同进入执行周末；全球系统同时接受规则与承载力检验
zh-CN.intro: 北美关税倒计时、欧盟AI透明义务、单人创业、气候风险、世界骄傲节、爱丁堡艺穗节、晨空观测与原住民议题共同进入行动窗口。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 变化真正落地时，预算、流程与责任必须一起更新。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 世界的每条线，都在测试下一次拉力。

en-US.headlineFact: Tariffs, AI, climate and culture enter an execution weekend
en-US.headlineView: global systems face tests of rules and capacity
en-US.headlineFull: Tariffs, AI, climate and culture enter an execution weekend; global systems face tests of rules and capacity
en-US.intro: North American tariff deadlines, EU AI transparency, solo entrepreneurship, climate risk, WorldPride, Edinburgh culture, skywatching and Indigenous issues enter action windows together.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When change becomes real, budgets, processes and accountability must update together.
en-US.doudouQuote: Every thread in the world is testing the next pull.

sources.title: Imposing Additional Duties To Offset Canadian Discrimination Against the Commerce of the United States With Respect to Dairy

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美加部分商品关税进入8月19日倒计时
zh-CN.headlineView: 原产地、品类与到岸成本必须重新核算
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美加部分商品关税进入8月19日倒计时；原产地、品类与到岸成本必须重新核算
zh-CN.intro: 美国宣布对加拿大歧视性乳制品措施采取额外关税，部分商品自8月19日起面临50%附加税；跨境卖家需复核品类、原产地、报关与库存路线。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 关税变化不能只交给物流商，利润表必须提前模拟。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 货还没出仓，成本已经先过了一道关。

en-US.headlineView: origin, category and landed cost need recalculation
en-US.headlineFull: US-Canada tariff deadline approaches August 19; origin, category and landed cost need recalculation
en-US.intro: The United States announced additional duties responding to Canadian dairy measures, with some goods facing a 50 percent surcharge from August 19; sellers must review classification, origin, customs and inventory routes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Tariff shifts cannot be left only to carriers; margin models need advance scenarios.
en-US.doudouQuote: Before goods leave the warehouse, cost has crossed another border.

sources.title: Imposing Additional Duties To Offset Canadian Discrimination Against the Commerce of the United States With Respect to Dairy

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI透明义务进入实施首周
zh-CN.headlineView: 披露、机器标记与审计链成为产品能力
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI透明义务进入实施首周；披露、机器标记与审计链成为产品能力
zh-CN.intro: 自8月2日起，部分AI交互以及生成或操纵内容须更清楚地披露身份、机器可读标记与来源；企业开始把法规要求落实到界面、输出管线和审核记录。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 透明不是发布前补一个水印，而是产品、数据和审计共同承担的能力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把来源说清楚，再让内容跑得更远。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: EU AI transparency enters its first week
en-US.headlineView: disclosure and machine marking become product capabilities
en-US.headlineFull: EU AI transparency enters its first week; disclosure and machine marking become product capabilities
en-US.intro: From August 2, certain AI interactions and generated or manipulated content require clearer disclosure, machine-readable marking and provenance across interfaces and output pipelines.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transparency is not a final watermark; product, data and audit systems must share it.
en-US.doudouQuote: Explain where content came from before sending it farther.

sources.title: Commission publishes guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems

zh-CN.headlineFact: AI让单人创业更容易入场
zh-CN.headlineView: 头部成果仍更依赖团队复利
zh-CN.headlineFull: AI让单人创业更容易入场；头部成果仍更依赖团队复利
zh-CN.intro: 对超过16万款Product Hunt产品的研究显示，生成式AI显著提高单人创业者进入市场的比例，尤其在过去依赖团队的品类；但高排名成果仍更多来自团队项目。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI降低做出来的门槛，却没有取消判断、分销与协作带来的复利。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一个人更容易开场，冲到前排仍要会借力。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineView: top outcomes still favor team compounding
en-US.headlineFull: AI makes solo entry easier; top outcomes still favor team compounding
en-US.intro: A study of more than 160,000 Product Hunt launches found that generative AI increased solo entry, while teams remained more prominent among the highest-ranked outcomes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI lowers the making threshold but does not erase the compounding value of judgment, distribution and collaboration.
en-US.doudouQuote: One person can start faster; reaching the front still takes leverage.

sources.title: Generative AI Fuels Solo Entrepreneurship, but Teams Still Lead at the Top

zh-CN.headlineFact: 强厄尔尼诺或把2027年推向新高温纪录
zh-CN.headlineView: 企业需要把气候风险纳入跨年度计划
zh-CN.headlineFull: 强厄尔尼诺或把2027年推向新高温纪录；企业需要把气候风险纳入跨年度计划
zh-CN.intro: 气候科学家警告，增强中的厄尔尼诺将与人为变暖叠加；即使2026年未刷新纪录，2027年仍很可能成为现代观测中最热的一年。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 高温风险不是一次天气事件，而是能源、供应链与健康预算的长期变量。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 今年没破纪录，不代表明年的温度计会客气。

en-US.headlineFact: Strong El Nino could push 2027 toward record heat
en-US.headlineFull: Strong El Nino could push 2027 toward record heat; businesses need multi-year climate planning
en-US.intro: Scientists warn that a strengthening El Nino will compound human-driven warming; even if 2026 misses the record, 2027 is widely expected to challenge modern heat records.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Heat risk is a long-term variable for energy, supply chains and health budgets.
en-US.doudouQuote: A record missed this year does not make next year cooler.

sources.title: Global Seasonal Climate Update for June-July-August 2026

zh-CN.headlineFact: 阿姆斯特丹世界骄傲节迎来闭幕日
zh-CN.headlineView: 大型公共活动连接权利、文化与城市运营
zh-CN.headlineFull: 阿姆斯特丹世界骄傲节迎来闭幕日；大型公共活动连接权利、文化与城市运营
zh-CN.intro: 世界骄傲节于8月8日举行游行和闭幕音乐会，为期两周的活动考验公共交通、安全、场地、旅游与社区协作。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 城市包容不是一句口号，也是一套可执行的公共服务。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一场盛会的后台，藏着整座城市的协作能力。

en-US.headlineFact: WorldPride Amsterdam reaches its closing day
en-US.headlineView: public events connect rights, culture and city operations
en-US.headlineFull: WorldPride Amsterdam reaches its closing day; public events connect rights, culture and city operations
en-US.intro: WorldPride holds its march and closing concert on August 8, testing transit, safety, venues, tourism and community coordination after two weeks of events.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Urban inclusion is not only a message; it is an executable public service.
en-US.doudouQuote: Behind a major event sits a whole city's coordination capacity.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 水星现身8月8日黎明微光
zh-CN.headlineView: 短暂观测窗口连接公众与行星科学
zh-CN.headlineFull: 水星现身8月8日黎明微光；短暂观测窗口连接公众与行星科学
zh-CN.intro: 水星在日出前低空出现，观测者需要兼顾时间、地平线、天气与安全；短窗口让精确计划成为体验的一部分。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 越短的窗口，越需要把时间、地点和工具提前对齐。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 清晨的一小点亮光，也值得准时抬头。

en-US.headlineFact: Mercury appears in August 8 morning twilight
en-US.headlineView: a short window connects public observing and planetary science
en-US.headlineFull: Mercury appears in August 8 morning twilight; a short window connects public observing and planetary science
en-US.intro: Mercury appears low before sunrise, requiring observers to align timing, horizon, weather and safety; the brief window turns planning into part of the experience.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The shorter the window, the more time, place and tools must align in advance.
en-US.doudouQuote: A small morning light is still worth looking up on time.

sources.title: Mercury at highest altitude in morning sky

zh-CN.headlineFact: 爱丁堡艺穗节进入首个完整周末
zh-CN.headlineFull: 爱丁堡艺穗节进入首个完整周末；3600多场演出考验城市承载力
zh-CN.intro: 第79届爱丁堡艺穗节超过3600场节目分布在258个场地，票务、住宿、交通、场馆与独立创作者同步进入高负荷运行。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 文化节的价值，也在城市如何承接密集创造力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 舞台越多，后台协作越像一场大演出。

en-US.headlineFact: Edinburgh Fringe enters its first full weekend
en-US.headlineView: more than 3,600 shows test city capacity
en-US.headlineFull: Edinburgh Fringe enters its first full weekend; more than 3,600 shows test city capacity
en-US.intro: The 79th Edinburgh Festival Fringe spreads over 3,600 shows across 258 venues, pushing ticketing, lodging, transport, venues and independent creators into high-load operations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A festival's value also lies in how a city carries concentrated creativity.
en-US.doudouQuote: More stages make backstage coordination a performance of its own.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 世界原住民日进入最后准备
zh-CN.headlineView: 文化权利必须连接土地、语言与治理
zh-CN.headlineFull: 世界原住民日进入最后准备；文化权利必须连接土地、语言与治理
zh-CN.intro: 联合国世界原住民日将于8月9日到来，提醒社会把文化表达与土地权利、语言传承、公共服务和参与治理放在同一框架。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 尊重文化不是借用符号，而是理解权利、语境与主体。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 看见纹样，也要看见创造它的人和土地。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：原住民议题。

en-US.headlineFact: World Indigenous Peoples Day enters final preparation
en-US.headlineView: cultural rights must connect land, language and governance
en-US.headlineFull: World Indigenous Peoples Day enters final preparation; cultural rights must connect land, language and governance
en-US.intro: The UN observance arrives August 9, linking cultural expression with land rights, language continuity, public services and participation in governance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Respecting culture means understanding rights, context and agency, not borrowing symbols.
en-US.doudouQuote: See the pattern, and also the people and land that created it.

sources.title: International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples
